defaults.motion_elements: the fire, the tree lights and the snow outside
defaults.ambient: The fire flickers in the great fireplace. Snow falls outside.

shots.subject: A manor great hall with a massive carved stone fireplace ablaze, a thick garland with red bows along the mantel, a very tall tree in red and gold, oak panelling hung with landscape oil paintings and mullioned windows with snow outside
A manor library with dark oak bookcases, a green leather chesterfield, garlands with red berries along the shelves, a fire in a marble fireplace and a tall window with snow falling

A long panelled manor gallery with wreaths and red bows hung on its tall windows, a red runner on polished boards, landscape paintings in gold frames, candle sconces glowing and a lit tree at the far end
shots.focus: the tree at the far end
shots.motion_elements: the candle sconces, the tree lights and the snow outside the windows
shots.ambient: Candle flames flicker in the sconces. Snow falls outside the tall windows.

shots.subject: A stone manor house front in deep snow, every mullioned window glowing gold, a huge wreath on the oak door, lanterns along a gravel drive and tall pines strung with lights
shots.motion_elements: the glowing windows, the lanterns, the lit pines and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls over the drive. Lantern flames flicker.

shots.subject: A Victorian manor conservatory of white iron and glass, potted palms and citrus trees wound with fairy lights, a small tree with red ornaments, wicker chairs and snow settled on the glass roof and falling outside
shots.motion_elements: the fairy lights, the tree lights and the snow falling outside the glass
shots.ambient: Snow falls outside the glass walls.

shots.subject: A manor dining hall with a long oak table set for a feast, silver candelabras with lit red candles, a runner of pine and holly, and a tall tree beside a stone fireplace with a fire
shots.motion_elements: the candle flames, the fire and the tree lights
shots.ambient: Candle flames flicker on the table. The fire flickers in the fireplace.

shots.subject: A manor entrance hall with a wide oak staircase rising to a landing, its carved banister wound with garland and red bows, a tall tree at the foot, a stone fireplace burning on one side and a lantern chandelier above
shots.ambient: The fire flickers in the fireplace.

shots.subject: A stone fireplace mantel with a garland of fir, holly and pinecones, red velvet stockings, brass candlesticks with lit candles and the fire glowing below
shots.motion_elements: the candle flames, the fire glow and the garland lights
shots.ambient: Candle flames flicker. The fire glows and flickers below.

shots.subject: A small castle hall with rough stone walls and a vaulted ceiling, an iron ring chandelier of lit candles, a huge hearth with a roaring log fire, a tall tree in red and green and deep window recesses with snow outside
shots.motion_elements: the fire, the candle chandelier, the tree lights and the snow outside
shots.ambient: The log fire flickers in the hearth. Candle flames flicker on the chandelier. Snow falls outside.

shots.subject: A manor drawing room with red damask walls, a gilt mirror over a marble fireplace with a fire, a garland along the mantel and a tree in the bay window with snow falling beyond
A manor music room with a harp and a pianoforte, garlands on gilded mirrors, a tree with red velvet bows and a fire in a small marble fireplace, tall windows with snow outside
The snowy inner courtyard of a manor at night, a frozen stone fountain wrapped in a lit garland, lanterns on the walls, glowing windows all around and a tall lit tree in the centre
shots.motion_elements: the lanterns, the glowing windows, the tree lights and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls into the courtyard. Lantern flames flicker.

shots.subject: A silver tray with a crystal decanter, two glasses, mince pies and a sprig of holly on a side table by the fire, the flames glowing out of focus behind
shots.motion_elements: the fire glow behind and the tree lights
shots.ambient: The fire flickers in the background.

shots.subject: A manor window seat in a deep stone bay with red velvet cushions and a tartan throw, a garland along the leaded windows and snow falling on the lamplit park outside
shots.motion_elements: the garland lights and the snow falling outside
shots.ambient: Snow falls outside the leaded windows.

shots.subject: A timber-framed Tudor manor hall with dark beams and white plaster, holly and ivy over every beam, a long refectory table, a tall lit tree and a stone fireplace with a log fire
A manor vestibule with a boot bench, tartan blankets and a small lit tree, lanterns on either side of the oak front door with a great wreath, its glazed upper panes showing snow falling on the drive
shots.motion_elements: the lantern flames, the tree lights and the snow outside the door
shots.ambient: Snow falls outside the door. Lantern flames flicker.

shots.subject: The great hall tree hung with red glass baubles, tartan bows, gold pinecones and warm bulbs, the stone fireplace glowing out of focus behind
shots.ambient: The fire flickers out of focus behind.

shots.subject: A double-height manor saloon with a minstrels' gallery hung with garlands, a tall tree reaching up toward it and a pair of fireplaces burning at either end
shots.focus: the tall tree and the gallery

shots.subject: A corner of a manor sitting room with a chess table set by the fire, two green velvet wingback chairs, a garland over the fireplace, a small tree and a window with snow falling
A pair of brass fire dogs and crackling logs in a stone hearth, a garland hanging from the mantel edge above and red stockings at the edge of the frame
shots.motion_elements: the flames and glowing embers of the log fire
shots.ambient: The log fire crackles and flickers.
